text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished everything on 
today's schedule, I call out to Cesario.
choice_data_list:
Good work. Shall we wrap things up for 
today?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: お疲れ様。今日はもう上がろうか
choice_data_list_en: Good work. Let's wrap up for today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Umm... you can relax now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No... I'm merely enduring a headache—
choice_data_list: ええと……もうリラックスしていいよ？
choice_data_list_en: Uhm... you can relax now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I am sorry. I will just head home for 
today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario seems to be troubled by a 
headache.
